name: UI：策略详情-节点类型弹窗完整验证
description: 打开策略详情页，点击新增节点，验证弹窗中显示全部20种节点类型及其描述文案。

steps.description: 验证策略列表页已加载
点击第一条策略的打开按钮

steps.expression: (() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal:not(.ant-modal-hidden)'); if (!modal) return { hasModal: false }; const title = modal.querySelector('.ant-modal-title'); return { hasModal: true, title: title?.textContent.trim() }; })()
steps.description: 验证节点类型弹窗标题
验证关键节点类型存在
